inherits.boolean_master: round5_cegar_v12.py Boolean-only assertion relaxation plus replay-authenticated v12 power cuts
inherits.meaning: no v15 mathematical constraint is removed or replaced

semantic_boolean_universe.source: all uninterpreted Bool constants occurring in encoding groups or frozen full assertions
semantic_boolean_universe.excluded: every constant whose printed name begins track_
semantic_boolean_universe.completion: every candidate model is evaluated with model_completion=True for every semantic Bool

assignment_check.formula: the raw inherited quantifier-free Bool plus LRA plus native PB formula
assignment_check.fixing: one fresh selector per semantic Bool, with selector implying Bool=value; all selectors are check assumptions

blocker_admission.projection: only fresh fix selectors from the UNSAT assumption core
blocker_admission.replay: projected fixes must replay UNSAT against a fresh solver containing the frozen full assertions
blocker_admission.blocker: disjunction of the opposite values of the replayed core assignment
blocker_admission.empty_core: allowed only after fresh replay proves the frozen full formula UNSAT

records: transitive v15, v14, v13, v12, and v8 formula/schema hashes
Z3 version, seed, threads, and budgets
frozen full and Boolean-master formula hashes
projected core, replay, blocker, and cumulative blocker hashes

terminal_status.process_exit: nonzero when any requested case is incomplete

trust_boundary: external Z3 evidence for the exact-n15 finite encoding; not by itself a Lean theorem or universal closure
